mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near the Verona Public Library and the moon is in its third quarter phase. If you look to the west-southwest near Mount Horeb around 7:06 PM, you can catch a two-minute flyover of the space station as it travels toward Belleville.

October is officially Community Planning Month, a time to recognize our dedicated city planners. Also, if you are looking for fresh air, the Senior Center is offering free 30-minute tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail.
There is plenty to do with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, plus the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow, and the Farley Center Fall Festival this Saturday.
Looking at the weekly report, on September 21, a retail theft occurred at a business on East Verona Avenue where a suspect was identified stealing candy via surveillance footage.
Today's flavor of the day is the decadent Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:30 PM tonight.
